description: List tickets the specified Zendesk user is following. Returns all tickets where the specified user is a follower. Use when you need to retrieve all tickets a particular user is watching or tracking, such as for notification purposes, audit trails, or understanding which tickets a user has interest in. Pagination is available for large result sets; follow next_page links until null to retrieve all followed tickets.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for getting tickets followed by a specific user.

exclude_archived.description: If true, excludes archived tickets from the results.
exclude_archived.human_parameter_description: Toggle to hide archived tickets from the results.
exclude_archived.title: Exclude Archived

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: traditional uses '?page=2' (integer page number), cursor uses '?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor' (deepObject with size, after, before). These are mutually exclusive.
page.human_parameter_description: Page number for offset pagination or cursor token for cursor-based pagination.
page.title: Page

per_page.description: Number of tickets to return per page (max 100).
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many tickets to show per page. You can choose up to 100.
per_page.title: Per Page

sort_by.human_parameter_description: Pick the ticket field to sort results by.
sort_by.title: Sort By

sort_order.human_parameter_description: Choose ascending (asc) or descending (desc) sort direction.
sort_order.title: Sort Order

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the user whose followed tickets to retrieve. This is the user ID found in ticket payloads (assignee_id, requester_id, submitter_id, author_id) or from user listings.
user_id.human_parameter_description: The unique ID of the Zendesk user. Find this in ticket payloads (assignee_id, requester_id) or via ZENDESK_LIST_USERS.
user_id.title: User Id
